 which an expression is to be considered as {#nAmaDeya#} (name of the {#yAga#})
 if the {#guRa#} implied or stated by that expression is found to be stated by another

 statement. This rule is discussed by {#jEmini#} and {#Sabara#} at <ls>MS. I. 4. 4</ls>.
